shops.title: Shops & Restaurants
shops.hubSubtitle: Explore the shops, restaurants, bars and services available in the terminals of N'djili International Airport.
shops.directorySubtitle: Find all shops and services available in the airport terminals.
shops.directoryNote: Hours may vary on public holidays and during operational disruptions.
shops.restaurantsSubtitle: From authentic Congolese flavours to international cuisine, discover our dining offer.
shops.shopsSubtitle: Congolese crafts, souvenirs, press and pharmacy for your last-minute shopping.
shops.barsCafesSubtitle: Kivu coffee, Congolese beers and tropical cocktails to relax before boarding.
shops.exchangeSubtitle: Exchange your currencies at our official bureaux de change. USD, EUR, CDF available in both terminals.
shops.exchangeWarning: Refuse any informal exchange outside accredited offices. Rates from unofficial vendors are not guaranteed and transactions may be illegal.
shops.ratesDisclaimer: Indicative rates provided for information only. Actual rates applied by bureaux de change may differ. Check the displayed rates at each office.
shops.dutyFreeSubtitle: FIH Duty Free offers a wide selection of tax-free products for international passengers.
shops.dutyFreeLocation: International Terminal — Departure lounge (after passport control)
shops.allowancesNote: These limits apply to travellers entering the DRC. For other destinations, check the customs rules of the destination country.
shops.allowancesDisclaimer: Customs information provided for guidance only. The DGDA (Directorate General of Customs and Excise) is the competent authority.
shops.loungesSubtitle: Enjoy a moment of comfort before your flight in the VIP lounges at N'djili Airport.
shops.loungesNote: Access conditions are subject to change. Please check with your airline's staff.
shops.hoursNote: Hours may vary on Congolese public holidays and during operational disruptions.

guide.title: Airport Guide
guide.hubSubtitle: Everything you need to know before, during and after your visit to N'djili International Airport (FIH).
guide.leavingKinshasaDesc: Complete departure procedure: check-in, security, immigration
guide.leavingSubtitle: Complete guide to the departure procedure at N'djili International Airport.
guide.leavingNote: These times are estimates. Always allow extra time, especially during peak hours or busy travel periods.
guide.fihExpressSubtitle: FIH Express provides priority treatment from check-in to the boarding gate.
guide.fihExpressNote: Booking recommended 24h before departure. Payment by Mobile Money or card accepted. Subject to availability.
guide.luggageSecurityDesc: Prohibited items, liquid rules, baggage allowances
guide.securitySubtitle: Everything you need to know about security rules and baggage allowances at N'djili Airport.
guide.baggageNote: Allowances shown are indicative. Always check the conditions of your airline.
guide.arrivingKinshasaDesc: Arrival at FIH: immigration, baggage, customs, exit
guide.arrivingSubtitle: Guide to the arrival procedure at N'djili International Airport (FIH).
guide.customsSubtitle: Information on controls by the Directorate General of Migration (DGM) and the Directorate General of Customs and Excise (DGDA).
guide.customsNote: This information is provided for guidance only. Customs and immigration regulations are subject to change. Consult the DRC embassy in your country before travelling.
guide.connectionsDesc: Connecting flights — minimum times and procedure
guide.connectionsSubtitle: Information for passengers making a connection at N'djili Airport.
guide.connectionsNote: If you miss your connection due to a delay on your first flight, contact your airline immediately for rebooking on the next available flight.
guide.healthSubtitle: Health information for travellers to or from the DRC.
guide.healthNote: This information is indicative. Consult a travel medicine specialist before your departure.
guide.wifiConnectivityDesc: Free Wi-Fi and mobile operators at the airport
guide.wifiSubtitle: Stay connected at N'djili International Airport with free Wi-Fi and mobile operators.
guide.wifiNote: Wi-Fi speed may vary depending on traffic. For critical business needs, prepare a mobile data plan.
guide.bankingSubtitle: ATMs, bureaux de change and practical tips for managing your money in Kinshasa.
guide.lostFoundDesc: Report or recover a lost item at the airport
guide.lostFoundSubtitle: Lost something at N'djili Airport? Our lost and found office is here to help.
guide.lostFoundSuccessDesc: We have received your declaration. If your item is found, we will contact you within 72 hours.
guide.lostFoundNote: FIH accepts no liability for lost items. Items not claimed after 90 days are handed over to the authorities.
guide.unaccompaniedMinorsDesc: UM service for children travelling alone
guide.minorsSubtitle: Escort service for minors travelling alone on flights departing from or arriving at FIH.
guide.minorsNote: Notarised parental authorisation is mandatory for minors travelling outside the DRC. Check the requirements of your airline.
guide.disabledSubtitle: N'djili Airport is committed to providing an accessible travel experience for all passengers, regardless of their mobility situation.
guide.pmrPrenotifyDesc: To ensure the best possible assistance, inform your airline of your need for PRM help at the time of booking, and contact FIH at least 48 hours before your flight.
guide.ssrDesc: When booking, provide the SSR code corresponding to your situation to your airline.
guide.ssrNote: SSR codes are IATA international standards. Each airline may have specific procedures.
guide.yellowFeverAlert: Yellow fever vaccination certificate mandatory to enter DRC
guide.yellowFeverDetails: All travelers entering the Democratic Republic of Congo must present an up-to-date international vaccination certificate for yellow fever. Systematic check upon arrival.

corporate.title: Corporate
corporate.hubSubtitle: Institutional information about the Régie des Voies Aériennes (RVA), operator of N'djili International Airport (FIH), Kinshasa, DRC.
corporate.aboutDesc: Mission, values and overview of RVA and FIH
corporate.aboutSubtitle: The Régie des Voies Aériennes (RVA) is the Congolese public enterprise responsible for managing all airports and airfields in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
corporate.governanceDesc: Board of directors, committees and management
corporate.governanceSubtitle: RVA's governance is ensured by a board of directors appointed by the Congolese government, supported by advisory committees.
corporate.futureProjectsSubtitle: RVA is investing heavily in modernising N'djili International Airport to bring FIH up to international standards.
corporate.historyDesc: From 1953 to today — 70 years of Congolese aviation history
corporate.historySubtitle: From the colonial inauguration in 1953 to today's modernisation, trace 70 years of history at N'djili Airport.
corporate.careersSubtitle: Join the RVA family and contribute to the growth of Congolese aviation.
corporate.partnershipsSubtitle: N'djili International Airport offers many commercial opportunities in a fast-growing market.
corporate.airServicesDesc: Cargo, general aviation and commercial aviation
corporate.airServicesSubtitle: N'djili Airport is the most important cargo and commercial aviation hub in Central Africa.
corporate.safetyDesc: ICAO standards, ARFF, SMS, safety commitment
corporate.safetySubtitle: Safety and security are at the heart of RVA's mission. Discover our commitments and dedicated structures.

community.title: Community
community.hubSubtitle: RVA is committed to the riverside communes of Nsele, Masina and Kimbanseke, the Pool Malebo environment and sustainable development.
community.envSubtitle: RVA is committed to reducing the environmental footprint of N'djili Airport and protecting the ecosystems of Pool Malebo and the Congo River.
community.noiseSubtitle: Understanding and managing the noise impact of N'djili Airport on the riverside communes of Nsele, Masina and Kimbanseke.
community.noiseComplaintSuccessDesc: Your complaint has been submitted to the noise environment service. We will respond within 15 working days.
community.runwayWorksSubtitle: Information on ongoing and planned works on the runways and taxiways of N'djili Airport.
community.communityRelationsDesc: Local initiatives, FIH Art, advisory committee
community.communitySubtitle: RVA actively engages with the riverside communes through concrete development and education initiatives.
community.committeeDesc: The community advisory committee meets quarterly to discuss RVA projects and the concerns of riverside communes.
community.riverineCommunesDesc: N'djili Airport is entirely surrounded by four communes of Kinshasa, home to more than 2.4 million residents directly impacted by airport operations.

hub.title: Parking & Transport
hub.subtitle: Official RVA parking, accredited taxis, buses, shuttles and access information
hub.parkingDesc: P1, P2, P3 car parks with online booking
hub.rentalDesc: Avis, Europcar, Hertz, Loxea and more
hub.pmrDesc: Parking and assistance for reduced mobility passengers
hub.worksAlertDesc: Disruptions possible in P2 car park until August 2026.

parking.subtitle: Book your parking space online. Payment by Mobile Money or credit card.
parking.infoDesc: Car parks are monitored 24/7 by RVA security. Keep your ticket on entry.

offres.subtitle: Official RVA rates in USD. CDF equivalent available at payment desks.
offres.mobileMoneyDesc: Pay your parking fee directly via Airtel Money, M-Pesa or Orange Money.
offres.condition1: Payment must be made before leaving the car park.
offres.condition2: Lost ticket: $20 USD flat fee applies.
offres.condition3: Mobile Money payment available at payment terminals.
offres.condition4: Rates are in USD, CDF equivalent at daily rate.

taxis.subtitle: Only take RVA-accredited official taxis. Identifiable by their yellow plate and FIH logo.
taxis.warningDesc: Unlicensed drivers offer services at the terminal exit. Refuse and go to the official signposted area.
taxis.howTitle: How to take an official taxi
taxis.step1: Exit the terminal through the main exit
taxis.step3: Choose your taxi (yellow plate + FIH logo)
taxis.step4: Agree on the fare before getting in
taxis.tariffNote: Indicative fares. Negotiate before departure. Traffic may affect cost.

bus.subtitle: The Transco/Esprit de Vie network offers regular lines between the airport and Kinshasa's main districts.
bus.infoDesc: Buses depart from the public transport zone (T1 exit, left). Payment in CDF or USD cash on board.

shuttles.subtitle: Major Kinshasa hotels offer shuttles to and from the airport. Booking recommended.

rental.subtitle: Several car rental agencies are available on arrival at FIH.

pmr.subtitle: N'djili Airport is equipped to welcome passengers with reduced mobility.
pmr.parkingDesc: Reserved spaces closest to terminal entrances. Free on presentation of supporting documents.
pmr.assistanceDesc: RVA staff are available to accompany wheelchair passengers from the entrance to the boarding gate.
pmr.medicalDesc: A nurse is on duty 24/7 for minor medical emergencies at the International Terminal.
pmr.contactDesc: Call at least 48 hours before your flight to arrange personalised assistance.
pmr.requestDesc: To arrange your assistance in advance, contact our dedicated team at least 48 hours before your flight.

dropoff.subtitle: Drop-off and pick-up zones at N'djili Airport.
dropoff.deposZoneDesc: In front of the International Terminal main entrance — 3 lanes available.
dropoff.deposTimeDesc: 15 minutes free. Beyond that, use P1 (short stay, $2/h).
dropoff.deposAlert: Extended stops not permitted in front of the terminal. Risk of fine.
dropoff.deposIntro: Drop off your passengers smoothly right in front of the International Terminal. Three quick drop-off lanes are available, directly accessible from Boulevard Lumumba.
dropoff.deposStep1Desc: Take Boulevard Lumumba and follow the 'Departures' signs. Stay in the outer lane reserved for drop-off.
dropoff.deposStep2Desc: 3 lanes are available in front of the main entrance. Luggage can be unloaded directly from your vehicle.
dropoff.deposStep3Desc: Drop-off time is limited to 15 minutes. Beyond that, proceed to P1 car park (short stay, $2/h).
dropoff.pickupZoneDesc: P1 car park ground floor — 200m from Arrivals hall exit.
dropoff.pickupTimeDesc: 30 minutes free for passengers waiting for arrivals.
dropoff.pickupIntro: Welcome your loved ones in the best conditions. P1 car park is ideally located 200m from the Arrivals hall, with 30 free minutes for those waiting.
dropoff.pickupStep1Desc: From Boulevard Lumumba, follow the green signage towards the Arrivals Terminal and P1 car park.
dropoff.pickupStep2Desc: P1 car park is on the ground floor, 200m from the Arrivals hall exit. The first 30 minutes are free.
dropoff.pickupStep3Desc: Walk to the Arrivals hall from P1. A luggage trolley service is available at the exit.
dropoff.rule1: Extended stops in front of the terminal are strictly prohibited — risk of fine and towing.
dropoff.rule2: For waits over 15 minutes, use P1 car park (short stay). Rate: $2/hour.
dropoff.rule3: Passengers with reduced mobility (PRM) benefit from reserved spaces near the main entrance.
dropoff.rule4: RVA-approved taxis have a dedicated pick-up zone — avoid informal taxis for your safety.

works.subtitle: Information on ongoing works and disruptions at N'djili International Airport.

carpooling.subtitle: Use RVA-accredited carpooling apps for your trips to or from the airport.
carpooling.zoneDesc: Accredited carpooling vehicles must park in P2 (ground floor). Pick-up in front of the terminal is prohibited.

limo.subtitle: Premium transport services with high-end vehicles and professional drivers.

blvd.subtitle: Boulevard Lumumba is the main access road to N'djili International Airport from Kinshasa.
blvd.trafficAlert: Frequent traffic jams during rush hours (7–9am and 5–7pm) on Boulevard Lumumba. Allow an extra 30 minutes.
blvd.timesNote: Estimated times excluding traffic. Allow 30–45 extra minutes during rush hours.
